cultural.vision_reason: A leather double saddle-bag with beaded cross motifs and applied cloth trim, a type of equestrian/nomadic gear plausible for Siberian/Central Asian peoples such as the Evenki; no outsider or distant-tradition evidence contradicts the attribution, though cross-tribal style overlap is common in the region.

physical.title: saddle-bag
physical.summary: A double saddle-bag made of leather, each capacious bag fastened with leather drawstring.  Each bag flap and narrow 'neck' between decorated with applied blue and thinner red tabby cotton cloth.  Red cloth narrows to piping between two bags.  Identical beadwork on each flap: cross (+) in the centre, with six stylized human (?) figures beside cloth border.  Worked in red, green and black glass beads, with transparent and light blue beads used near the 'neck'.  Two round metal discs on each motif.  Small diamond motifs between arms of cross and on two sides.  Red and blue glass beads suspended on leather strips from shaped bag edge.
